scope: Proposition 3.48 (A negative ray with an actual detector) of the manuscript “Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Log-abundance-for-compact-Kahler-spaces-under-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 70. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Bd. Let A be a gklt adjoint in dimension at most d on a globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler space, with globally nef carrier data. Let R be an A-negative extremal ray of the full analytic cone. If an actual global rational line L has L · R < 0, the ray has a projective contraction; a small contraction has its detected flip. The working models retain the strong factoriality and compact Kähler properties. In particular this applies to an ordinary rational adjoint A = c1(KX + B) with detector KX + B, and to ordinary real boundaries by Proposition 3.19.
